citations.assessment: The Bavli puts the three teachings under one attribution, while the edition of Heilprin repeats the introductory formula.
Rashi says the three teachings were heard together and recited together. Heilprin contrasts that with his reading of the small Alfasi's wording.
The teaching about blessing a fragrance uses the same Zutra–Tuvyah–Rav chain.
Zutra transmits Rav’s interpretation of Psalms 144:12 in the Hosea discussion.
The ten things with which the world was created are taught by Zutra in Rav’s name.
The checked 13a lacks the attribution; the teaching about where the river of fire discharges is expressly attributed to Zutra son of Tuvyah in Rav’s name on 13b.
One of three chains names Mar Zutra bar Tuvyah in Rav’s name.
The rule about testimony by separated witnesses is transmitted by the same chain.
The rule for the sin-offering bird is transmitted by the same chain.
The account names Zutra’s mother, her marriage and divorce, and the appearance before Bibi in the resulting property case.
The first segment sets the recitation before Rav Yehudah. The immediately following segment has Zutra place himself under censure for one day.
The witness names Zutra son of Tuvyah as transmitting from Rav Nachman in the discussion of disclosing sins.

holds.raw: באלפסי קטנים פי' ג' דברים אלו שמע מרב וגרס בהדדי
holds.reason: The precise wording printed in the cited small Alfasi edition remains uncollated.
